description: This file defines the EventHubStreamOptions class and related configuration classes for setting up Azure Event Hub streaming options within Orleans. It includes methods for configuring connections with various credential types, validation logic, and associated validator classes.

classes.name: EventHubOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Event Hub in Orleans, including connection setup with various credentials and validation logic.

classes.name: EventHubOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the configuration of EventHubOptions to ensure necessary connection parameters are set.

classes.name: StreamCheckpointerConfigurationValidator
classes.description: Validates that a stream checkpointing service is properly configured.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverOptions
classes.description: Specifies options for the Event Hub receiver, such as prefetch count and start position.

classes.name: EventHubStreamCachePressureOptions
classes.description: Configures cache pressure monitoring thresholds for Event Hub stream caching.

methods.name: ConfigureEventHubConnection
methods.description: Multiple overloads for configuring Event Hub connection with string credentials, fully qualified namespace + credential objects, EventHubConnection instances, or delegate functions.

methods.name: ValidateValues
methods.description: Private method ensuring eventHubName and consumerGroup are valid, non-empty strings.
